title: Sprint 7 velocity below target — carryover risk
description: Sprint 7 is only 37% complete (22 of 60 story points) with 5 working days remaining. At current pace, approximately 40% of planned work will carry over to Sprint 8, potentially delaying OKR-1 and OKR-2 milestones.
mitigation: Re-scope sprint: move t012 (CI/CD optimization, 4pts) and t014 (load testing, 3pts) to Sprint 8 backlog. Unblock t004 by scheduling a 30-minute data schema review with Lior H. and Dan K. today. Ensure t001 is Yael M.'s top priority.

title: OKR-2 (Reduce Churn) at critical risk — all KRs behind
description: NPS improvement (KR2.1) is only 21% of target. Churn reduction (KR2.2) is at 33% of target. The churn prediction model (KR2.3) is 10% complete, and its critical dependency — the data schema migration (t004) — has been blocked for 3 days.
mitigation: Escalate data schema approval to CTO. Consider reducing scope of churn prediction model for Q2 — focus on manual detection rules first, then automate in Q3. Schedule OKR-2 recovery review with Dan K. and Oren S. this week.

title: Design dependency creating cascade block on frontend
description: t001 (User Onboarding Flow, 5pts) and t013 (QA regression, 3pts) are both blocked by the same Design handoff from Maya R. If t001 is not complete by June 13, regression testing (t013) cannot start, and the Sprint 7 demo will have a visible gap in the onboarding feature.
mitigation: Schedule Design-Dev sync for June 11 morning. Maya R. to deliver final UX specs by EOD June 11. Move t001 due date to June 13 and flag it as top blocker. Tali G. can use June 12-13 to prepare test environment.

title: Lior H. is overloaded — single point of failure for infrastructure
description: Lior H. owns 9 open tasks across 2 boards including 2 critical items (t011, t021) and 1 stuck item (t023). Infrastructure progress for OKR-3 depends almost entirely on one person. This is a significant delivery and knowledge risk.
mitigation: Defer t024 (SSL automation) and t035 (DR docs) to Sprint 8 backlog. Escalate security team approval for t023 DR testing. Explore whether Dan K. can support t021 Kubernetes config after completing t002. Consider contractor support for Sprint 8 infrastructure work.

title: QA coverage gap — regression tests dependent on blocked feature
description: Tali G.'s Sprint 7 QA plan depends on t001 (onboarding flow) being complete. With t001 stuck, t013 cannot proceed. This means the Sprint 7 demo will go out without full regression coverage on the onboarding feature — the most user-visible item in this sprint.
mitigation: Plan a reduced demo scope if t001 is not shippable by June 13. Tali G. to scope unit-level testing that is not blocked by t001 completion. Ensure sign-off gates are clear for the demo day review.

title: Sprint 8 scope at risk due to Sprint 7 carryover
description: Sprint 8 is planned at 65 story points. If Sprint 7 carries over 10-15 points (t001, t004, t008, t013), Sprint 8 capacity will be partially absorbed by carryover before new work begins. The churn prediction model (t018, 8pts, OKR-2 critical) may slip to Q3.
mitigation: Hold a sprint planning pre-meeting on June 16 to assess Sprint 7 carryover. Adjust Sprint 8 scope before the sprint start. Prioritize t018 and t020 as must-have items in Sprint 8 regardless of carryover.

title: Data pipeline knowledge gap — single expert (Noa T.)
description: Noa T. is the only team member with deep expertise in the data event pipeline. t026 (user notifications) and t027 (pipeline optimization) both depend on her. If she is unavailable, both tasks stall with no backup. This is a growing bus-factor risk as data work expands in Sprint 8.
mitigation: Schedule a data pipeline knowledge-transfer session with Dan K. in Sprint 7. Document the event schema and pipeline architecture in Notion. Add cross-training as a Sprint 8 OKR-4 goal.

title: Cross-training deficit — OKR-4 KR4.1 significantly behind
description: OKR-4 (Team Health) KR4.1 targets cross-training completion for critical system areas. Current progress is only 30%. With 3 weeks remaining in Q2, achieving this KR requires at least 2 cross-training sessions per week. Currently no sessions are scheduled.
mitigation: Schedule bi-weekly cross-training pairing sessions starting Sprint 8. Assign Ron A. to coordinate the cross-training schedule and track completion in the team OKR dashboard.
